Lemma
[energy minimality of the sine variation]

↗ lem:dc-ch9-2-3-smooth-variation-energy-min ↗ lem:dc-ch9-3-1-sine-variation

1. ch9:3.1If $\gamma :[0,1]\to M$ is a distance-minimizing geodesic and $e$ is a parallel field as in section 2, then the energy of the sine exponential variation has a local minimum at $s=0$.
Proof

\sketch The sine exponential variation is smooth on a product neighborhood, has zero slice $\gamma $, and fixes both endpoints by section 2. Apply section 1.

□
